title: Roller coasters facilitate the passage of small kidney stones
description: A urologist noticing patients reporting stone passage after theme park visits ran a controlled study using a 3D-printed kidney model with real kidney stones and urine. Riding in the rear car of Big Thunder Mountain Railroad at Disney World produced a ~64% stone passage rate vs ~17% in the front car. Proposed mechanism: oscillating acceleration disrupting stone-to-wall contact at the ureteropelvic junction.
